t: You're looking at 10 Palace Gate, an apartment block in Kensington. It was designed by Wells Coates, an architect, designer and writer. Coates was a Canadian who spent most of his life abroad. He is best known for his work in England, above all the Modernist block of flats called the Isokon building in Hampstead. This Kensington block is another of his residential designs, so it is worth a look if you know the Isokon.
